# AI-Knowledgebase

Using your own copy? Open `README.md` in this folder to start.

A research wiki you build with an AI assistant such as Claude or Codex. You give it sources, and it turns them into linked pages that say what's known, where it came from, and what's still unknown. The example wiki is for a neighborhood group planning a community garden. No coding needed.

*A side track: build a research wiki with an AI assistant. No coding needed.*

It's one of the example projects from [Mac Install Guide](https://mac.install.guide/developer-setup/starter-project).

## Get it

**With an app.** In the Yaxed editor, choose **File > New Project**.

**Without an app.** Make your own copy on GitHub with **Use this template**, or download the `.zip` from the latest release and unzip it into a folder of your own.

## Use it

Open the folder with your AI assistant, then read `README.md`. Start reading the wiki at `wiki/index.md`.

## Feedback

Found a problem, or have a suggestion? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/InstallGuides/AI-Knowledgebase/issues). This project doesn't take pull requests.
